title: [BUG] VS Code crashes and reloads
body:
## Environment  
- Platform (select one):  
  - [x] Other: Claude Code (via VS Code extension / CLI)  
- Claude CLI version: <!-- replace with actual version -->  
- Operating System: Windows 11 (WSL environment)  
- Terminal: VS Code integrated terminal  

## Bug Description  
My sessions are completely stopping mid-use and it's progressively getting worse. The entire VS Code window forcefully shuts down and reloads. When this happens, the active session ends abruptly and I’m required to re-enter my API key every time. This is highly disruptive and frustrating when working on active builds or feature execution.

## Steps to Reproduce  
1. Launch Claude Code in VS Code (inside WSL)  
2. Begin working on a session with multiple Claude prompts  
3. At some random point (often mid-task), VS Code crashes and reloads  
4. Session is lost, and Claude CLI prompts for API key again  

## Expected Behavior  
Claude sessions should persist unless explicitly closed. VS Code should not crash or force a reload, and I should not have to re-authenticate with my API key every time.

## Actual Behavior  
- VS Code window shuts off completely and restarts  
- All Claude session data is lost  
- API key prompt reappears, even if previously saved  
- Work is interrupted and has to be restarted  

## Additional Context  
This issue seems to be increasing in frequency. It appears worse when multiple Claude threads are running or when heavier prompts are issued. The reset is similar to a hard crash and happens without warning.
